description: Main entry point for a Flutter application that previews local HTML assets in a WebView. Defines the main app widget, a page listing HTML files with navigation, and includes path sanitization logic.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the application, sets theme and home page.

classes.name: HtmlListPage
classes.description: Stateful widget displaying a list of HTML assets for preview.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that runs the app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for MyApp and HtmlListPage.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the input controller when HtmlListPage is destroyed.

methods.name: sanitizeAssetPath
methods.description: Sanitizes input paths to enforce asset path conventions and security.

methods.name: _openPath
methods.description: Navigates to WebViewScreen with the sanitized asset path.
